translations.web: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: Then will I make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord Jehovah.
